name: Lincoln Gap - Long Trail trailhead
parking_notes: Small lots at the top of Lincoln Gap Rd; fill on fall weekends. Pull-offs on the way up on the Warren side give brook access. Road unpaved near the top and closed in winter.
notes: Lincoln Brook starts just below the gap and follows the road down to Warren village. Long Trail north to Mt Abraham, Sunset Ledge spur.

name: Appalachian Gap - Long Trail parking (Rte 17)
parking_notes: Roadside lot at the top of the gap; free.
notes: Mill Brook rises on the Fayston side and follows Rte 17 all the way down past Mad River Glen.

name: Mad River Glen base lots (Rte 17)
parking_notes: Big lots at the base area, 57 Schuss Pass; normally open off-season, check for events.
notes: Mill Brook runs right past the base area along Rte 17.

name: Phen Basin Trailhead (Battleground Rd, Fayston)
parking_notes: Park in the signed visitor parking just before the covered bridge at the Battleground (off Rte 17), parallel to the road; do not drive over the bridge.
source_ref: Google Places (reviews describe parking and trail)
notes: Trail climbs about 2 miles up an old logging road beside a small cascading brook that drains to Mill Brook (verify the brook's name against the hydrography layer).

name: Mad River Path - Millbrook Trailhead (Harris Hill Rd)
parking_notes: NO PARKING at the trailhead itself (signed). Park across from Fayston Elementary School on German Flats Rd and walk in.
notes: Mill Brook Trail: 1.5 mi with a 200-ft bridge over Mill Brook, co-located with the Catamount Trail through Chase Brook Town Forest toward the Battleground. Serves both the Mill Brook and Chase Brook (Fayston) B1 points.

name: Fayston Elementary School lot (German Flats Rd)
coord_source: geocoded 2026-09-24: Nominatim OSM way/569773662: Fayston Elementary School, 782, German Flats Road, Fayston, Warren, Washington C
parking_notes: The sanctioned parking for the Millbrook Trailhead per signage; avoid school hours.
source_ref: Google Places reviews on the trailhead listing
notes: Geocode: Fayston Elementary School, German Flats Rd, Fayston VT.

name: Sugarbush - Lincoln Peak base lots (Gate House Ln)
parking_notes: Large lots at 62 Gate House Ln off Sugarbush Access Rd; free outside ski season.
notes: Clay Brook's B1 survey point is about 1 km east along the access road; Rice Brook about 1.3 km. Clay Brook follows Sugarbush Access Rd down to the Mad.

name: Sugarbush - Mt Ellen base (Mt Ellen Rd / German Flats Rd)
parking_notes: Lots at 626 Mt Ellen Rd; open off-season. German Flats Rd pull-offs.
notes: Slide Brook basin is about 1.5 km south; the Chase Brook (Fayston) point is about 1.4 km east along German Flats Rd.

name: Hedgehog Brook Trailhead (end of Big Basin Rd, North Fayston)
parking_notes: Marked lot before the steel gate at the end of the drivable road; trail crosses private land — obey no-parking signs and don't block the gate.
notes: The trail immediately crosses Shepard Brook (ladder + stepping stones; a ford in high water) then climbs beside Hedgehog Brook to the Long Trail / Burnt Rock. Directions: North Fayston Rd west from Rte 100 (4.5 mi north of Rte 17); dirt after 2.5 mi; straight at the 4-way at 4.0 mi onto Big Basin Rd; trailhead at 5.0 mi.

name: Blueberry Lake Trails parking (1825 Plunkton Rd, East Warren)
parking_notes: USFS lot on the east side of Plunkton Rd; trailheads across the road. From Warren Main St: Brook Rd 1.9 mi, right on Plunkton Rd 1.8 mi.
notes: Closest USFS lot to the inn (about 10 min). The lake's dam is on Mills Brook; the lake is stocked with brook trout (report p.8). Gentle multi-use trail loops.

name: Austin Brook Trail / Forest Road 25 gate
coord_source: geocoded 2026-09-24: Austin Brook VHD line, downstream end (mouth at Rte 100) - FR 25 gate not in OSM, verify on site
parking_notes: USFS gate at the start of unplowed FR 25; roadside parking. Find the gate off Rte 100 south of Warren — verify on the USFS page.
notes: The trail follows FR 25 about 2 miles up along Austin Brook through mixed forest.

name: Warren Falls lot (3919 Rte 100)
parking_notes: Lot plus roadside spaces; fills on hot afternoons. Short Warren Falls Trail from 3916 Rte 100.
notes: Upstream of the falls toward Granville the Mad is small pocket water and mostly wild brookies.

name: Warren village - covered bridge / Main St
coord_source: geocoded 2026-09-24: Nominatim OSM way/1020925958: Warren Covered Bridge, Covered Bridge Road, Warren, Washington County, Vermont,
parking_notes: Street parking in the village; Warren Store.
notes: Geocode 'Warren Covered Bridge, Warren VT'. Village pools on the Mad; the Bradley Brook B1 point is about 1 km northwest.

name: Riverside Park (Warren, Rte 100)
parking_notes: Small lot; a Google review says parking is paid. Swimming hole with a tire swing.
notes: Start of the Kingsbury Greenway (1.3 mi along the Mad to the Sugarbush snowmaking pond).

name: Kingsbury Greenway - Wabanaki Conservation Area parking (500 Rte 100)
parking_notes: Flat, easy lot right off Rte 100; open 24h.
notes: Other end of the Kingsbury Greenway; flat short path with river access.

name: Lareau swimming hole (Rte 100, Waitsfield)
parking_notes: Roadside pull-off at 5919 Main St (Rte 100).
notes: Popular swim spot on the Mad between Warren and Waitsfield; fish early.

name: Waitsfield covered bridge / Bridge St (Great Eddy)
parking_notes: On-street parking in the village.
notes: Village reach (stocked). Bridge Street Park beach; The Silver Trout fly shop is next door.

name: Mad River Greenway - Meadow Rd trailhead (Waitsfield)
parking_notes: Lot on the right just before the Meadow Rd bridge, 3.8 mi north of the Rte 100/17 junction. Don't block the business at the south end of the lot.
notes: West Greenway: 1.2 mi out-and-back along the Mad with several river access points and a gazebo; the East Greenway continues to the Tremblay Rd lot.

name: Mad River Greenway - Tremblay Rd parking (Waitsfield)
coord_source: geocoded 2026-09-24: Nominatim OSM way/19728207 (Tremblay Rd), vertex nearest the Mad River VHD line
parking_notes: Mad River Path Association lot on Tremblay Rd.
notes: Geocode 'Tremblay Rd, Waitsfield VT' and put the pin at the river end.

name: Dog River Jacuzzi Natural Area - Berlin VFD lot (2095 VT-12)
parking_notes: Park in the Berlin Volunteer Fire Department lot just north of the Rte 12 bridge; look for the Dog River Park sign and walk down behind the station.
notes: Vermont River Conservancy access on a premier wild-trout river; this is also the report's 572-ft temperature site. Near the reduced-harvest stretch (verify).

name: Roxbury Gap Rd / Warren Mountain Rd (the gap)
coord_source: geocoded 2026-09-24: Nominatim OSM node/205084130: Roxbury Gap, Warren, Washington County, Vermont, United States
parking_notes: Unpaved road over the Northfield Range from Brook Rd in Warren to Roxbury; pull-offs only.
notes: The direct route from the inn to the Dog River side (~25 min). The Felchner Brook B1 point is on the Roxbury side of the gap — verify which road it's nearest.

name: Moss Glen Falls pull-off (Granville Gulf, Rte 100)
coord_source: geocoded 2026-09-24: Nominatim OSM node/1951272330: Moss Glen Falls, Granville, Addison County, Vermont, 05747, United States
parking_notes: Roadside pull-off on Rte 100 in Granville Gulf.
notes: Geocode 'Moss Glen Falls, Granville VT' (rough estimate 44.0275,-72.858). The Mad rises in the gulf; tiny headwater brookie water.
